text:
Type: long shaggy high-pile rug
Use: adding softness underfoot, beside a bed or under a coffee table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: extra long thick shag pile yarn
Colors: dark charcoal grey, cool
Shape: rectangular, very deep fluffy shag with tousled strands, soft irregular edges, bulky
Feel: cozy, plush, moody, enveloping
Goes with: white or light grey walls, black metal, light wood, cool textiles; modern or contemporary living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: GSER
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
